Module core

The primary interface to the NMReady hardware.

The Core provides access to the NMReady hardware. It also maintains the "active" configuration, which will be used for the next acquisition.

globals

lockLost()
Get whether the frequency lock was lost or not since the last time this function was called.

Returns:

    bool Whether frequency lock was lost or not
resetLockLost()
Reset the lockLost setting.
setNoAcquire(disable)
This method can be used to disable acquisitions. When disabled, the acquire() method will return immediately. It is useful when testing pulse sequence creation.

Parameters:

  • disable bool True: acquire() returns immediately. False: acquire() acts normally.
monotonicTime()
Get time in seconds and return it as a double. This is the only way to get an accurate measure of elapsed time. Other methods are affected by system time changes (e.g. daylight savings, NTP update, manual time change.) The value returned is only valid for as long as the software is running.

Returns:

    double Seconds that have elapsed since an arbitrary point in the past.

Class Core

The Core class maintains the system's active configuration as well as provides access to hardware.
